Red Star Football Club, commonly referred to as Red Star FC or simply Red Star, is a French professional football club founded in Paris in 1897. The club plays its home matches at the Stade Bauer. They currently compete in Ligue 2, the second tier of French football, having been promoted from the third tier Championnat National at the end of the 2023–24 season. The club is the fourth oldest football club in France after Standard AC of Paris, Le Havre AC and Girondins de Bordeaux.
